hints.title: Modulo State Tracking
hints.text: The divisor for any substring is solely determined by its final character.

hints.title: Remainder Updates
hints.text: Track the count of active substrings modulo each divisor from 1 to 9, updating remainders when appending a new digit.

hints.title: Zero Remainder Accumulation
hints.text: Whenever a non-zero digit x appears, accumulate the count of substrings with remainder zero modulo x.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Transitions through 45 remainder states across 9 divisors per character in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all substrings takes quadratic time and exceeds numeric limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DP table of size 45 uses constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains running modular arithmetic states across small divisors 1 through 9.
